authors.bio: Slusser is chairman of the Board of Digital Theater Systems, Inc. During more than 35 years, he has been involved in many aspects of the industry. He began his career in 1967 as industrial relations representative for Deluxe General, Inc. In 1970, he joined 20th Century Fox in New York as manager of labor relations, eventually moving to Fox's Los Angeles studio in 1972, as a manager of labor relations and employment. Among other positions, he has served as a corporate vice-president of MCA Inc., senior vice-president and general manager of Universal Studios, Inc., and chairman of the Universal Facilities Rental Division. Slusser is a current board officer and past chairman of the Permanent Charities Committee, a SMPTE Fellow, a member of the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences, and the Academy of Television Arts and Sciences. He also served on the Technical Committee of the Presidential Advisory Council for the Museum of Television and Radio. Additionally, he is a member and past two-term president of the Los Angeles Film Development Committee, a two-term chairman of the L.A. County Filming Advisory Board and past vice-chariman of the California State Film Commission. Slusser was the recipient of the SMPTE Presidential Proclamation Award in 1986.
